caseNameFull: CUDD v. MATHERS, JUDGE, NINTH JUDICIAL CIRCUIT OF ILLINOIS
attorneys: Charles S. Rhyne for appellant., Latham Castle, Attorney General of Illinois, and Raymond S. Sarnow, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
